about:
Grand Solar, Inc. was established in Honolulu, Hawaii, in 1980 and incorporated in 1985. The original owner, John Grandinetti, remains actively involved, attending every residential and commercial solar installation the company performs. The business began as a specialist in solar thermal system design, installation, and service, quickly becoming a leader across the Hawaiian islands.

The company designs, installs, and services a range of solar thermal technologies, including the Blazing Tubes system, conventional pump solar hot water systems, and thermosyphon solar hot water systems. It also installs residential photovoltaic systems using only U.S.-manufactured components, which carry industry-leading performance warranties. Grand Solar serves both residential and commercial customers throughout Hawaii.

Grand Solar’s customer base includes homeowners and businesses seeking solar thermal and photovoltaic solutions. The company has maintained an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau since 1990, and the Hawaii Regulated Industries Complaint Office has no record of complaints. It is also a member in good standing of the Hawaii Solar Energy Association.

Grand Solar differentiates itself through the founder’s hands-on presence at every job, a commitment to U.S.-sourced PV components, and long-standing industry affiliations that underscore its focus on reliability and customer satisfaction.
